# measured date

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:measuredDate`](gmeow-measuredDate.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/measuredDate>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The absolute date instant yielded by a temporal measurement. Semantically plays the [`observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) role for [`TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md), but is NOT asserted as [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) because [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) ([gufo:AbstractIndividual](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#AbstractIndividual)) is not a subclass of [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) ([gufo:Endurant](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Endurant)), the range of [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md). Projection-layer alignment to [time:hasTime](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#hasTime) lives in the mapping DSL.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a measurement yields an absolute calendar instant rather than an elapsed age — and, on a [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](../classes/gmeow-NamedPeriod.md)'s measurement, to drive the [`gmeow:periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md) property chain.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for elapsed-time results (use [`gmeow:measuredAge`](gmeow-measuredAge.md)) and do not expect it to behave as [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) — it deliberately is not a subproperty, since [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) is disjoint from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) under [gUFO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-gufo).

### How to use

- Point it at a single [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) (its frame and granularity ride the [`Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md)); on a period measurement this lets the [`periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md) chain infer the period's start without an explicit assertion.

### Examples

- ex:strataDate [`gmeow:measuredDate`](gmeow-measuredDate.md) ex:boundaryInstant.
